cases.summary: [Support]: When restarting Frigate, it raises AttributeError: 'Rknn' object has no attribute 'rknn'
cases.description:
### Describe the problem you are having

Hi, something for the dev branch again with an orange pi 5 plus.


I noticed that when saving the config and restarting frigate or even just triggering the restart frigate command from the 3 dot menu, I get this error.  When stopping the container and starting it again it doesnt exhibit this issue.


![image](https://github.com/blakeblackshear/frigate/assets/467007/d99f9521-2720-4d89-a96e-38a118e6331f)

### Version

0.13.0-4879DE26

### Frigate config file

```yaml
detectors:
  rknn:
    type: rknn
    # core mask for npu
    core_mask: 0b011

model:
  #path: default-yolov8n
  path: /models/yolov8n-320x320.rknn
  width: 320
  height: 320
  input_pixel_format: bgr             # required
  input_tensor: nhwc

go2rtc:
  streams:
    balcony:
    - rtsp://user:pass@ip/stream1
    - ffmpeg:rtsp_cam#audio=opus

  balcony:
    ffmpeg:
      output_args:
        record: preset-record-generic-audio-copy
      inputs:
      - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/balcony
        roles: 
          - detect
    detect:
      enabled: true
    objects:
      track:
        - person
        - cat
        - bird
        - dog
        - car
```

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix rknn crashing after restart

fixes #8659
evidence.eventual_fix_diff:
commit 977eef9138184f8e0627581d83719c9ccaf2c7ba
Author: Marc Altmann <40744649+MarcA711@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Sat Nov 18 22:36:24 2023 +0100

    fix chrash after restart (#8661)

diff --git a/frigate/detectors/plugins/rknn.py b/frigate/detectors/plugins/rknn.py
index a35721ced..38beec3b2 100644
--- a/frigate/detectors/plugins/rknn.py
+++ b/frigate/detectors/plugins/rknn.py
@@ -62,10 +62,11 @@ class Rknn(DetectionApi):
                 )
             )
 
-        if "rk356" in soc:
-            os.rename("/usr/lib/librknnrt_rk356x.so", "/usr/lib/librknnrt.so")
-        elif "rk3588" in soc:
-            os.rename("/usr/lib/librknnrt_rk3588.so", "/usr/lib/librknnrt.so")
+        if not os.path.isfile("/usr/lib/librknnrt.so"):
+            if "rk356" in soc:
+                os.rename("/usr/lib/librknnrt_rk356x.so", "/usr/lib/librknnrt.so")
+            elif "rk3588" in soc:
+                os.rename("/usr/lib/librknnrt_rk3588.so", "/usr/lib/librknnrt.so")
 
         self.model_path = config.model.path or "default-yolov8n"
         self.core_mask = config.core_mask
